#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef unsigned long long ull;

const ll INF = LLONG_MAX / 4;

struct Edge {
    int from, to;
    ll flow, capacity, cost;
    Edge* dual;
};

struct Node {
    int index;
    vector<Edge*> edges;
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    vector<Node*> nodes;
    MaxFlowSolver() {}
    MaxFlowSolver(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) addNode();
    }
    Node* addNode() {
        Node* n = new Node();
        n->index = nodes.size();
        nodes.push_back(n);
        return n;
    }
    void link(Node* n1, Node* n2, ll cap, ll cost = 1) {
        Edge* e12 = new Edge();
        Edge* e21 = new Edge();
        e12->from = n1->index; e12->to = n2->index; e12->capacity = cap; e12->flow = 0; e12->cost = cost;
        e21->from = n2->index; e21->to = n1->index; e21->capacity = 0; e21->flow = 0; e21->cost = -cost;
        e12->dual = e21;
        e21->dual = e12;
        n1->edges.push_back(e12);
        n2->edges.push_back(e21);
    }
    virtual ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
    virtual ~MaxFlowSolver() {}
};

class MinCostMaxFlowSolver : public MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver() : MaxFlowSolver() {}
    MinCostMaxFlowSolver(int n) : MaxFlowSolver(n) {}
    virtual pair<ll, ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) = 0;
    virtual ~MinCostMaxFlowSolver() {}
};

class EdmondsKarp : public MinCostMaxFlowSolver {
public:
    ll minCost;
    EdmondsKarp() : MinCostMaxFlowSolver() {}
    EdmondsKarp(int n) : MinCostMaxFlowSolver(n), minCost(0) {}
    
    pair<ll, ll> getMinCostMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        ll maxflow = getMaxFlow(src, snk);
        return {maxflow, minCost};
    }
    
    ll getMaxFlow(Node* src, Node* snk) override {
        int n = nodes.size();
        int source = src->index;
        int sink = snk->index;
        ll flow = 0;
        ll cost = 0;
        vector<ll> potential(n, 0);
        while (true) {
            vector<Edge*> parent(n, nullptr);
            vector<ll> dist(n, INF);
            dist[source] = 0;
            priority_queue<pair<ll, int>, vector<pair<ll, int>>, greater<pair<ll, int>>> pq;
            pq.push({0, source});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto item = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                ll d = item.first;
                int v = item.second;
                if (d != dist[v]) continue;
                for (Edge* e : nodes[v]->edges) {
                    int to = e->to;
                    ll temp = dist[v] + e->cost + potential[v] - potential[to];
                    if (e->capacity > e->flow && dist[to] > temp) {
                        dist[to] = temp;
                        parent[to] = e;
                        pq.push({temp, to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == nullptr) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] < INF) potential[i] += dist[i];
            }
            ll augFlow = INF;
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from) {
                augFlow = min(augFlow, parent[i]->capacity - parent[i]->flow);
            }
            for (int i = sink; i != source; i = parent[i]->from) {
                Edge* e = parent[i];
                e->flow += augFlow;
                e->dual->flow -= augFlow;
                cost += augFlow * e->cost;
            }
            flow += augFlow;
        }
        minCost = cost;
        return flow;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    EdmondsKarp solver;
    vector<int> people(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        cin >> people[i];
        people[i]--;
    }
    Node* src = solver.addNode();
    Node* snk = solver.addNode();
    const int amt = 150;
    vector<vector<Node*>> timeNodes(N, vector<Node*>(amt, nullptr));
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j < amt; ++j) {
            timeNodes[i][j] = solver.addNode();
            if (j > 1) {
                solver.link(timeNodes[i][j-1], timeNodes[i][j], INF, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        solver.link(src, timeNodes[people[i]][1], 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < amt; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
            solver.link(timeNodes[0][i], snk, 1, (ll)C * i - C);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 1; j < amt - 1; ++j) {
            int prev = 0;
            for (int k = 1; k <= K; ++k) {
                ll cost = (ll)D * k * k - prev;
                solver.link(timeNodes[a][j], timeNodes[b][j+1], 1, cost);
                solver.link(timeNodes[b][j], timeNodes[a][j+1], 1, cost);
                prev = D * k * k;
            }
        }
    }
    auto ret = solver.getMinCostMaxFlow(src, snk);
    cout << ret.second << "\n";
    return 0;
}
